text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft had still not awakened... Even 
so, her Trainer refused to give up. After 
all, she had reached out to grasp a 
miracle with her own hands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer gathers the Tiara Umamusume 
and rushes to Line Craft's hospital room. 
Together, they all desperately call out to 
her, promising to compete against each 
other again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, in a dream, Rhein Kraft 
confronted another version of herself. 
That "self" spoke... saying she had been 
unable to leave anything behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's not true, Rhein Kraft denies. 
Everyone looked up to me. If I can leave a 
piece of myself within someone—we can stay 
connected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then, the bonds connecting everyone 
worked a miracle— and Rhein Kraft opened 
her eyes.
